title: A cosmetic thread on a shaft extruded from a sketch on the Front plane keeps the shaft where it is

expect.note: the book replay (wave 7, replay-e): the Tesla Turbine's inlet got a cosmetic pipe thread after an extrude whose step has a placement of its own (a sketch on a face or a side plane), and the whole body turned a quarter turn: the thread copied the step before with its placement, which a thread step does not keep (thread.in_place). The shaft (radius 6, 40 long, its middle 30 up Z on the Front plane, extruded to -Y as every Front-plane extrude is) stays where the extrude put it: V = pi 6^2 40 = 4523.893, bbox [-6, -40, 24, 6, 0, 36]
